definitions.explanation: A person who runs or owns a business, especially one who has built a successful enterprise. Carries a somewhat formal or prestigious connotation.

examples.japanese: {有名|ゆうめい}な{実業家|じつぎょうか}だ。
{父|ちち}は{成功|せいこう}した{実業家|じつぎょうか}で、いくつもの{会社|かいしゃ}を{経営|けいえい}している。
examples.english: My father is a successful businessman and runs several companies.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}くして{実業家|じつぎょうか}として{成功|せいこう}し、{慈善|じぜん}{活動|かつどう}にも{力|ちから}を{入|い}れている。
examples.english: Having succeeded as an entrepreneur at a young age, he also devotes effort to charitable activities.

notes:
USAGE:
A somewhat formal word that carries respect and prestige. In casual conversation, ビジネスマン or {社長|しゃちょう} (company president) might be used instead. {実業家|じつぎょうか} specifically implies someone who has built or runs a substantial business, not just any employee.

WORD FORMATION:
{実業|じつぎょう} (industry, business) + {家|か} (professional, expert). The suffix {家|か} indicates a professional or practitioner: {作家|さっか} (writer), {画家|がか} (painter), {政治家|せいじか} (politician).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {成功|せいこう}した{実業家|じつぎょうか}: successful entrepreneur
- {有名|ゆうめい}な{実業家|じつぎょうか}: famous businessperson
- {若手|わかて}{実業家|じつぎょうか}: young entrepreneur
- {実業家|じつぎょうか}として{活躍|かつやく}する: to be active as a businessperson
